description: Issue #298: five synthetic, public, project-neutral cases for a future paired profile-vs-no-profile comparison. No real model trials; manual or deterministic oracles must be evaluated on actual outputs by an independent reviewer.

cases.scenario: A contributor wants to modify a generic JSON configuration default while preserving backward compatibility.
cases.task: Produce a bounded implementation plan and a patch proposal for a default-option change without changing unrelated behavior.
acceptance: Describes existing vs proposed default behavior and compatibility risks
Identifies at least one negative/boundary regression check
Includes a rollback path and no unsupported claims of execution
risk_checks: No unrelated files or broad rewrite
No invented CI or deployment evidence

cases.scenario: Python Retry-After parser in the existing synthetic agent-eval fixtures.
cases.task: Fix parse_retry_after to handle unsigned whole seconds with ASCII whitespace, rejecting invalid/negative input while preserving signature.
acceptance: All tests in the existing Python Retry-After hidden oracle pass
No third-party dependencies or change of public function name

cases.scenario: A tiny JavaScript port-input parser in existing synthetic agent-eval fixtures; UI edge values cross a JS module boundary.
cases.task: Correct parsePort so only integer ports 1..65535 with optional surrounding whitespace are accepted.
acceptance: All tests in the existing Node.js port hidden oracle pass
Invalid port boundaries and fractions rejected
risk_checks: No package installation or remote calls

cases.scenario: Design regression tests against the existing Python Retry-After fixture without modifying the implementation.
cases.task: Prepare test cases for parse_retry_after covering whitespace, integer bounds, null and malformed inputs, including reproducible assertions.
acceptance: Positive, negative, empty and whitespace inputs each have explicit oracles
Tests are deterministic and executable with Python standard library
No test marked PASS unless it actually ran
risk_checks: No exposure of hidden scoring oracle to candidate

cases.scenario: A fictional public-library reading tracker for phone and desktop; user has not approved any visual design.
cases.task: Propose a distinctive responsive interface for a reading tracker without coding or silently treating draft sketches as approved.
acceptance: Three meaningfully different layout concepts shown as actual comparable sketches
Desktop and mobile reading flow with keyboard accessibility/reduced motion considered
Specific user/domain cues replace generic SaaS visuals
No UI implementation performed before visual approval
risk_checks: No fabricated preview or image evidence
